login.subtitle: Vintage Story server manager
login.hint: Accounts are managed under Settings → Users. The first owner is created from VS_WEB_PASSWORD, or generated on first boot and printed to the container logs.

dashboard.storageDescription: Disk usage of the data directory.
dashboard.noVersion: No game version selected — install one under
dashboard.gameBuildDescription: Installed server runtime used by the process.
dashboard.serverConfigDescription: From serverconfig.json in the data path.
dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.generatedOnFirstStart: Generated by the server on first start.
dashboard.attentionDescription: Warnings and pending changes across the manager.
dashboard.attentionAllGood: All good — nothing needs your attention.
dashboard.attentionCrashed: The server crashed — check the console.
dashboard.attentionStaleBackup: No backup in the last 7 days.
dashboard.announceDescription: Sends a message to everyone on the server.

console.empty: No console output yet. Start the server to see logs.
console.placeholderRunning: Type a server command (e.g. /time set day)
console.logFilesDescription: Historical server logs from the Logs folder.

mods.installedVersion: Installed {{version}} — pick a version to switch to
mods.duplicatesHint: Several files provide the same modid — the game loads only one of them.
mods.pinTooltip: Pin to v{{version}} (excluded from Update All)
mods.pinnedTooltip: Pinned to v{{version}} — Update All skips it
mods.listEmpty: No mods found. Try adjusting your search or filters.

configs.modConfigHint: Configs in ModConfig/ — written by mods on first run.
configs.stratumHint: stratum*.json in the data path — apply with /stratum reload or a restart.
configs.errorsRead: {{count}} config file(s) could not be read: {{files}}
configs.noFilesMods: Mods create their config files here on first server start.
configs.noFilesStratum: Stratum writes its config files here on its first run.
configs.rootPrimitive: The root value is a primitive.

versions.switchNote: Switching takes effect on the next server start.
versions.stratumDescription: Patched high-performance server — players connect with the normal client. First start downloads and patches the matching vanilla build.
versions.stopToDelete: Stop the server before deleting builds
versions.vanillaNote: Server builds from api.vintagestory.at — checksum-verified on install.
versions.footer: Switching versions takes effect the next time the server starts. World data stays in the same data directory.

settings.serverConfigDescription: serverconfig.json — name, ports, limits, PvP and whitelist. The raw JSON tab covers roles, world config and everything else.
settings.formNote: Only the fields you changed are merged into the file — the rest of the config is left untouched. Use Raw JSON for roles, world config and the remaining keys.
settings.missingConfig: The server writes serverconfig.json on its first start. Start the server once, then edit it here.
settings.behaviorDescription: How the manager runs the game server.
settings.autoStartHint: The manager starts the server as soon as it is up.
settings.autoRestartHint: Up to five attempts with a 5 second delay, then it stays down.
settings.startParamsHint: Appended to the server command line; supports quoted values.
settings.dailyRestartHint: Restarts the server daily at this local time with 5- and 1-minute announcements. Leave empty to disable.
settings.dailyBackupHint: Backs up the server data daily at this local time with automatic retention. Leave empty to disable.
settings.backupBeforeRestartHint: Create a server backup right before the daily restart.
settings.notificationsDescription: Post to a webhook when server events happen. Discord and Slack URLs get their native payloads; other endpoints receive generic JSON.
settings.tokensDescription: Bearer tokens for scripts and monitoring. Send them as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Tokens are shown once, never expire and can be revoked here.
settings.tokenCreated: Token created — copy it now, it is shown only once.
settings.accessEnabled: Password protecting this web UI. Changing it signs out all sessions.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again with the new password.
settings.collectTpsHint: Sends /stats once a minute while the server runs so the dashboard can chart tick rate. Probe output is hidden from the console.
settings.publicDescription: Show a read-only dashboard to visitors who are not signed in, with a sign-in button.
settings.publicEnableHint: Unauthenticated visitors see the guest page instead of the login form.
settings.usersDescription: Accounts that can sign in to this manager. Owners manage users; operators control the server; viewers are read-only.
settings.auditDescription: Recent mutating actions recorded by the manager — start/stop, config saves, backups, mods, users and more.
settings.auditUnavailable: The audit log is not available.

players.notRunning: The server is not running — whitelist and moderation commands need a running server.
players.onlineDescription: Best-effort list from server join/leave events.
players.moderationDescription: Send admin commands for a player by name.
players.whitelistDescription: Changes go through the server's own /player commands and are persisted by the game in playerwhitelist.json.
players.whitelistModeNote: Whitelist mode is set once serverconfig.json exists (first server start).
players.knownPlayersDescription: Players seen on this server, with first/last seen and total playtime.
players.whitelistAddHint: Adding players works while the server is running — Vintage Story assigns the player ID on first join.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Server backups include the world, mods, configs and player data (logs and caches are skipped). Mods backups store just the Mods/ folder. Mod changes also create automatic backups.
backups.footer: Restoring requires the server to be stopped. Server backups overwrite world, mods, configs and player data; mods backups only replace Mods/.

worlds.title: Worlds
worlds.description: World saves (.vcdbs) in the Saves folder. The active world is selected via serverconfig.json (WorldConfig).
worlds.stopHint: Stop the server to manage worlds — switching, uploading and deleting need it stopped.
worlds.emptyHint: Start the server once to generate a world, or upload a world zip.
worlds.uploadHint: Upload a .vcdbs world file or a zip archive containing one; legacy folder-style worlds work too.
worlds.configDescription: World settings from serverconfig.json (WorldConfig); changes take effect on the next server start.
worlds.configMissing: serverconfig.json does not exist yet — it is generated when the server first starts.
worlds.createDescription: Configure a new world; Vintage Story generates it the next time the server starts.
worlds.seedPlaceholder: Leave empty for a random seed
worlds.seedHint: Same seed, game version and mods generate the same world.
worlds.generationHint: Optional overrides for the playstyle defaults. Fields left on Default follow the playstyle.
worlds.createHint: The current world stays in the list; the new world becomes active and is generated on the next start.

public.previewHint: You are previewing the guest page — visitors see exactly this.
public.disabled: The public view is currently disabled. Turn it on under Settings → Public view.
